entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: One of five crime families of New Capenna, elite vampire assassins and art collectors, once the aristocracy of Old Capenna.

entities.name: Old Capenna
entities.description: The earlier city whose culture the Maestros preserved.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Vampire boss of the Maestros, formerly Xander's Deacon.

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.description: A vampire rogue of the Maestros.

entities.name: Museum of Old Capenna
entities.description: Maestros headquarters in Park Heights, obliterated by Atraxa.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Borough where the Maestros are found.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who compleated most of the Maestros.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Maestros were compleated.

events.summary: During Old Capenna's fall, the Maestros safeguard its historical and cultural works.
events.quote: they safeguarded historical and cultural works

events.summary: Atraxa compleats the vast majority of the Maestros during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The vast majority of the Maestros were compleated by Atraxa

events.summary: In her rage, Atraxa obliterates the Museum of Old Capenna.
events.quote: Atraxa obliterated the Museum of Old Capenna

relations.quote: The vast majority of the Maestros were compleated by Atraxa
